description.value: The Cheese Man is a specialty cheese retailer tucked behind Capilano Mall on the south side of West 3rd Street in North Vancouver — self-described as 'not easy to find but definitely worth the trip.' The shop carries a curated selection of cheeses and accepts cash only. It is a worthwhile provisions stop for touring cyclists seeking quality artisan food rather than a full grocery run.

address.value: 991 West 3rd Street, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1E4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms address (991 West 3rd Street North Vancouver BC V7P 1E4), phone (604-985-4527), and email (info@cheeseman.ca) matching OSM tags. The site presents a specialty artisan cheese retailer — not a general supermarket as OSM's shop=supermarket tag suggests — with sections for specials, recipes, and a photo gallery but no mention of bike parking, water access, washrooms, or any cycling infrastructure. OSM's currency:others tag notes cash-only payment, corroborated by no online payment mention on the site.
concerns: OSM shop=supermarket tag is incorrect; this is a small specialty cheese shop.
OSM opening hours (Tu-Fr 09:00-17:30; Sa 09:00-17:00) differ from the website (Tue-Sat 10:30-17:30, Mon/Sun closed) — website hours should be considered authoritative.
Cash-only payment (OSM: currency:others=CAD cash only) — no card payment evidence on website; cyclists should be aware.
No cycling infrastructure (bike parking, water, etc.) confirmed from any source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed operational specialty food retailer with matching contact details; a useful artisan provisions stop for touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver, fitting the Groceries category.
enrichment_extras.notes: The shop notes it can be hard to find: 'Behind Capilano Mall on the south side of 3rd St, between Lions Gate Cleaners and Robert's Sailboards.' Pre-ordering cheese is available per the website.
